title: The evaluate word fits its finished receipt with the shared strict budget rule and a bounded row-free envelope
outcome: The evaluate word fits its finished receipt with the shared strict budget rule and a bounded row-free envelope
acceptance: the evaluate word measures its finished receipt, including effective_session_id, with agent_receipt_fits (strictly under the agent budget) while shedding verdict rows, and never returns a row-free receipt it did not measure as fitting

the service preflight leaves a documented reserve for the word envelope so the row-free word receipt is bounded by construction; a test measures the row-free word overhead (lines, guidance, session metadata) on a maximal fixture and asserts it stays under the reserve, and the many-criteria verbs test asserts strict < for JSON and text

completion.summary: The evaluate word measures its finished receipt (effective_session_id included) with the shared strict agent_receipt_fits, sheds verdict rows then reminders then extra next commands, and never refuses after the commit; the service preflight fits under the budget minus EVALUATE_WORD_RESERVE, whose derivation from admitted field limits at worst-case escaping is written on the constant and pinned by the_reserve_covers_the_derived_word_envelope (maximal envelope built from a real receipt after asserting each assumed bound), with the_word_envelope_stays_within_its_reserve as a regression sample and the many-criteria test tightened to strict <. GREEN logs/20 and /22.
